verdict.rationale: Hummingbird documents grouping incoming alerts into cases, plus alert dispositioning and investigations, which covers the core idea of consolidating alerts into an investigation. CRM profiles with associated files suggest subjects are tied to the work. However, nothing shows analysts prioritizing alerts or explicitly grouping subjects and transactions into a case. Missing for 10: documented alert prioritization/triage ranking, explicit grouping of subjects and transactions into an investigation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
